gloss: (shogi) nifu; the illegal move of having two unpromoted pawns on the same file

definitions.gloss: (shogi) nifu; the illegal move of having two unpromoted pawns on the same file
definitions.explanation: In shogi, the foul of dropping a pawn ({歩|ふ}) onto a file (column) that already holds one of your own unpromoted pawns. It loses the game on the spot, and it is one of the best-known and most embarrassing fouls in the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二歩|にふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧しまい、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I dropped a pawn onto a file that already had one of my pawns and lost the shogi game on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二歩|にふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{反則|はんそく}{負|ま}け→反則負け：22305_hansokumake⟧になった⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: A game in which a professional shogi player lost by foul because of nifu became big news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{二歩|にふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Beginners who have just learned shogi often accidentally play nifu.

notes:
Made of ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ (two) and {歩|ふ}, the shogi pawn. The same kanji read にほ mean "two steps" ({二歩|にほ}); in shogi the pawn is read ふ, so the foul is にふ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二歩|にふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to commit nifu (to drop the second pawn)
- {二歩|にふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{反則|はんそく}{負|ま}け→反則負け：22305_hansokumake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to lose by nifu
- {二歩|にふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反則|はんそく}→反則：06541_hansoku⟧: the nifu foul

CULTURAL NOTE:
The rule is known even to people who do not play shogi, and a professional who commits nifu in a televised or title game makes the news.
